# A Meta-Analysis of Antecedents and Outcomes of Flexible Working Arrangements

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Tammy D. Allen, Timothy D. Golden, Kristen M. Shockley  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Organizational Behavior  
**DOI:** [10.1002/job.2896](https://doi.org/10.1002/job.2896)

**Keywords:** flexible working arrangements, flextime, flexplace, meta-analysis, work-life balance, remote work

## Abstract

Meta-analytic results based on 113 studies with 88,618 participants identify a host of important antecedents of flexible working arrangements (FWAs), such as managerial status, self-efficacy, and task interdependency, and examine outcomes including flextime, flexplace, and combined arrangements.
